name: OS Client Certs -- decrypt & re-encrypt S/MIME forward
description: When forwarding an S/MIME encrypted message, automatically decrypt the original, replace the raw smime.p7m blob with the decrypted content and attachments, and re-enable S/MIME encryption for the new recipients. Requires identity with S/MIME signing/encryption certificates. v0.2.2 (TEST): privileged ForwardIntercept Experiment redirects an embedded message/rfc822 forward directly to a reply at compose-open time, so a single reply window opens with the full decrypted content (no empty Forward-window flash).
